header.running_head: Honouring the Household Members of Rasulullaah ﷺ's Family

blocks.text: (who was still a child) came there and said, "Do dismount my grandfather's place!" Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said, "You are right. This place is your grandfather's." Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) then put Hadhrat Hasan (RA) on his lap and started to weep (thinking of Rasulullaah ﷺ). Hadhrat Ali (RA) excused himself saying, "By Allaah! This was not by my instruction." "That's true," Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) agreed, "I had no doubts about it."[^1]

Hadhrat Urwa (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) was once delivering a sermon when Hadhrat Hasan (RA) (who was still a child) arrived and also mounted the pulpit saying, "Do dismount my grandfather's pulpit!" Hadhrat Ali (RA) then said, "This was done without my consultation."[^2]

Hadhrat Urwa (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Umar (RA) was once delivering a sermon when Hadhrat Husayn (RA) (who was still a child) stood up and said, "Do dismount my grandfather's pulpit!" Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "It is indeed the pulpit of your grandfather and not that of mine. Who instructed you to do this?" Hadhrat Ali (RA) then stood up and said, "No one instructed him to do it! Take note, you rascal! I shall definitely punish you for this." Hadhrat Umar (RA) interceded by saying, "Do not punish my nephew for he has spoken the truth. By Allaah! It is certainly his grandfather's pulpit."[^3]

Hadhrat Husayn (RA) narrates, "I once climbed the pulpit on which Umar (RA) was and said, 'Do dismount my grandfather's pulpit and mount your father's pulpit!' 'My father does not have a pulpit,' he replied and he then made me sit with him. After dismounting and proceeding home, he asked, 'Dear child! Who taught you to do this?' When I assured him that no one did, he said, 'Dear son! It would be nice if you visited us frequently.' I therefore went to him one day but found him alone with Mu'aawiya (RA) while his son Abdullaah was standing at the door and did not have permission to enter. I therefore returned home. When Umar (RA) met me afterwards, he asked, 'Dear son! Why is it that you have not visited us?' I replied, 'I had come when you were alone with Mu'aawiya (RA). However, when I saw that your son Abdullaah had to return (without receiving permission to enter), I also returned.' He said, 'You are more deserving of permission than my son Abdullaah. Allaah has crowned our heads because of your family (Rasulullaah ﷺ).' He then placed his hand on my head."[^4]
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Honours Hadhrat Hasan (RA)
Hadhrat Uqba bin Haarith narrates that it was after the demise of Rasulullaah
Abu Nu'aym and Jaabiri in his Juz.
Ibn Sa'd, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.3 Pg.132).
